### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Attribute symptom durations only when explicitly stated for that specific symptom; avoid inferring or transferring durations from other symptoms.
[O-Section]: List objective findings strictly as observed in the physical exam; do not infer findings based on patient diagnoses.
[P-Section]: Differentiate between immediate patient instructions (e.g., 'contact if worsen') and specific agenda items for future follow-ups.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O-Section]: Report numerical objective findings (e.g., vital signs, measurements) only when explicitly stated; otherwise, use qualitative descriptions provided.
[P-Section]: For follow-up plans, include only agenda items explicitly stated by the provider for that specific follow-up; do not infer discussion topics from immediate patient instructions.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: State diagnostic relationships or potential etiologies only when explicitly articulated by the provider; avoid inferring general connections or 'may be related' statements between symptoms and conditions.
